title: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.23329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. translated_title: 超越视频思考：统一视频推理与深度研究以支持开放世界视频代理
translated_abstract: 开放世界视频理解通常要求模型定位稀疏的视觉证据，并获取视频及其参数化记忆中缺失的外部知识。虽然“视频伴随思考”能够实现主动的时间感知，而“深度研究”支持多步骤信息检索，但这两项能力通常被孤立地开发。我们引入了VideoRover，一个统一的视频深度研究框架，它迭代地协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览。给定一个视频-问题对，VideoRover利用每个工具的结果来选择下一个动作，从而使局部视频片段引导外部检索，而检索到的证据又触发进一步的视频检查和验证。为了发展这一能力，我们构建了一个自动化的数据整理流程，生成了26K条经过验证的SFT轨迹和3K个具有挑战性的RL实例。我们还引入了VideoRover-Bench，这是一个按视频时长分层的基准测试。
tldr: VideoRover统一了视频推理与深度研究，通过迭代协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览，实现开放世界视频代理的主动感知与外部知识获取。
en_tdlr: VideoRover unifies video reasoning and deep research by iteratively coordinating video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing, enabling active perception and external knowledge acquisition for open-world video agents.
